text:
Alex M.: PTAL — I pushed updates to infra/deploy#489 that address the review comments from last week. Quick summary:
- fixed retry backoff edge case
- added docs for the new healthcheck flag
- tightened the RBAC on the deployment job
- disabled a flaky e2e gate with a TODO to re-enable after tracking ticket

Diffs:```
commit 4a7b9f1 fix(retries): use jittered exponential backoff
commit b3c1d2e docs: add deploy-healthcheck.md
commit d9e8f7a ci: skip flaky e2e for now (JIRA-1234)
```
Planning to merge in Fri 14:00 UTC slot unless anyone objects. @nina can you take a quick pass for security/RBAC? :eyes:

Nina C.: Thanks — I can look today. Quick Q: any config or runtime behavior changes consumers should know about?

Alex M.: No runtime surface changes, only config default toggled to enable healthcheck. Example snippet:
```yaml
deploy.healthcheck.enabled: true
deploy.healthcheck.timeout_ms: 250
```
No schema changes to the API.

CI Bot: CI Report: build ✅, unit tests ✅, lint ✅, e2e: 1/3 failing (flaky) — see https://ci.internal/reports/489 for details.

Samir: I'll take the failing e2e and try to reproduce locally. If it's a CI flake we can re-run.

Leo (eng-infra): skimmed — LGTM modulo one nit on a log message (prefer structured logging). Can you change log line in deploy/healthcheck.go to use logger.With("check", "deploy").Info(...) ? :thumbsup:

Alex M.: Updated, pushed f7b3c. Also added a short note in the docs about the RBAC caveat.

Nina C.: Scanned the RBAC change, looks good to me. Approving.

Samir: Re-ran the failing e2e; it passed locally after a clean cache. Triggering CI re-run now.

CI Bot: CI Report (re-run): all checks passed ✅ — build, unit, lint, e2e.

Leo (eng-infra): approving now.

Samir: approving as well, no further comments.

Alex M.: Thanks all. I'll merge Fri 14:00 UTC and schedule a lightweight canary (10% traffic) for the first hour. Will post in #incidents if anything spikes. If anyone needs an earlier merge, say now.

Nina C.: Sounds good. Please note in the release notes about JIRA-1234 being open for the re-enable.

Alex M.: Will do. Merging in 30s...

CI Bot: Merge succeeded — infra/deploy#489 merged to main (commit 4a7b9f1). Canary rollout started at 1718513600.
